corrections.english: To take advantage of a multiprocessor system, an application must execute on multiple CPUs at the same time. This is *parallelism*, which an application may accomplish by using multiple processes (*multiprocess*) or multiple threads (*multithreaded*), each performing its own task. For reasons explained in [Chapter 6](#ch06-ch06), [CPUs](#ch06-ch06), [Section 6.3.13](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13), [Multiprocess, Multithreading](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13), multiple threads (or the equivalent tasks) are more efficient and are therefore the preferred approach.
corrections.before: 要利用多处理器系统，应用程序必须同时在多个 CPU 上执行。这就是“并行性”，应用程序可以通过使用多个进程（*多进程*）或多线程（*多线程*）来实现，每个线程执行自己的任务。由于[第 6 章](#ch06-ch06)、[CPU](#ch06-ch06)、[第 6.3.13 节](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13)、[多进程与多线程](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13)中解释的原因，多线程（或等效任务）效率更高，因此是首选方法。
corrections.after: 要利用多处理器系统，应用程序必须同时在多个 CPU 上执行。这就是“并行性”，应用程序可以通过使用多个进程（*多进程*）或多线程（*多线程*）来实现，每个进程或线程执行自己的任务。由于[第 6 章](#ch06-ch06)、[CPU](#ch06-ch06)、[第 6.3.13 节](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13)、[多进程与多线程](#ch06-ch06lev3sec13)中解释的原因，多线程（或等效任务）效率更高，因此是首选方法。

corrections.english: - A single global mutex lock for all data structures. While this solution is simple, concurrent access will encounter contention for the lock and latency while waiting for it. Multiple threads that need the lock will *serialize*—execute in sequence, rather than concurrently.
corrections.before: - 所有数据结构的单个全局互斥锁。虽然这种解决方案很简单，但是并发访问会遇到锁争用和等待时的延迟。需要锁的多个线程将“序列化”——按顺序执行，而不是同时执行。
corrections.after: - 所有数据结构的单个全局互斥锁。虽然这种解决方案很简单，但是并发访问会遇到锁争用和等待时的延迟。需要锁的多个线程将“串行化”——按顺序执行，而不是同时执行。
corrections.reason: Serialize here is sequential execution, not data serialization

corrections.english: A hash table of locks is an in-between solution and is suitable when lock contention is expected to be light. A fixed number of locks is created, and a hashing algorithm is used to select which lock is used for which data structure. This avoids the creation and destruction cost with the data structure and also avoids the problem of having only a single lock.
corrections.before: 锁哈希表是一种中间解决方案，适用于预期锁争用较少的情况。创建固定数量的锁，并使用哈希算法来选择哪个锁用于哪个数据结构。这避免了数据结构的创建和销毁成本，也避免了只有单个锁的问题。
corrections.after: 锁哈希表是一种中间解决方案，适用于预期锁争用较少的情况。创建固定数量的锁，并使用哈希算法来选择哪个锁用于哪个数据结构。这避免了随着数据结构创建和销毁而反复创建、销毁锁的开销，也避免了只有单个锁的问题。

corrections.english: Applications and runtimes sometimes provide their own profiler that runs in user mode, which cannot show kernel CPU usage. These user-based profilers may have a skewed notion of CPU time as they may be unaware of when the kernel has descheduled the application, and do not account for it. I always start with kernel-based profilers (perf(1) and profile(8)) and use user-based ones as a last resort.

corrections.english: - **Deadline**: Attempts to enforce a latency deadline; for example, read and write expiry times in units of milliseconds may be selected. This can be useful for real-time systems, where determinism is desired. It can also solve problems of *starvation*: where an I/O request is starved of disk resources as newly issued I/O jump the queue, resulting in a latency outlier. corrections.english: The confluence of two components has interfered with the adoption of jumbo frames: older network hardware and misconfigured firewalls. Older hardware that does not support jumbo frames can either fragment the packet using the IP protocol (causing a performance cost for the packet reassembly) or respond with an ICMP “can’t fragment” error, letting the sender know to reduce the packet size. Now the misconfigured firewalls come into play: there have been ICMP-based attacks in the past (including the “ping of death”) to which some firewall administrators have responded by blocking all ICMP. This prevents the helpful “can’t fragment” messages from reaching the sender and causes network packets to be silently dropped once their packet size increases beyond 1,500. If the ICMP message is received and fragmentation occurs, there is also the risk of fragmented packets getting dropped by devices that do not support them. To avoid these problems, many systems stick to the 1,500 MTU default.
corrections.before: 两个因素阻碍了巨型帧的采用：较旧的网络硬件和配置错误的防火墙。不支持巨型帧的旧硬件可以使用 IP 协议对数据包进行分段（导致数据包重组的性能成本），或者以 ICMP“无法分段”错误进行响应，让发送方知道减小数据包大小。错误配置的防火墙也会造成问题：过去曾发生过基于 ICMP 的攻击（包括“死亡之 ping”），一些防火墙管理员通过阻止所有 ICMP 来应对这些攻击。这可以防止有用的“无法分段”消息到达发送者，并导致数据包大小超过 1,500 时网络数据包被静默丢弃。如果收到 ICMP 消息并发生分片，则还存在分片数据包被不支持它们的设备丢弃的风险。为了避免这些问题，许多系统坚持使用 1,500 MTU 默认值。

corrections.english: Connection latency is similar to ping latency, although it exercises more kernel code to establish a connection and includes time to retransmit any dropped packets. This occurs during the TCP handshake, so connection latency can include retransmission latency, adding one or more seconds.

corrections.english: Network devices and networks accept packet sizes up to a maximum segment size (MSS) that may be as small as 1500 bytes. If the NIC and driver support TCP segmentation offload (TSO), GSO leaves splitting to the device, improving network stack throughput.[^fn-ch10-ch10-footnote-5] There is also a generic receive offload (GRO) complement to GSO [\[Linux 20i\]](#ch10-ch10ref58).[^fn-ch10-ch10-footnote-6] GRO and GSO are implemented in kernel software, and TSO is implemented by NIC hardware.

corrections.english: Packet sniffing (aka *packet capture*) involves capturing the packets from the network so that their protocol headers and data can be inspected on a packet-by-packet basis. For observational analysis this may be the last resort, as it can be expensive to perform in terms of CPU and storage overhead. Network kernel code paths are typically cycle-optimized, since they need to handle up to millions of packets per second and are sensitive to any extra overhead. To reduce this overhead, ring buffers may be used by the kernel to pass packet data to the user-level trace tool via a shared memory map—for example,[^fn-ch10-ch10-footnote-10] using BPF with perf(1)’s output ring buffer, and also using AF\_XDP [\[Linux 20k\]](#ch10-ch10ref61). A different way to solve overhead is to use an out-of-band packet sniffer: a separate server connected to a “tap” or “mirror” port of a switch. Public cloud providers such as Amazon and Google provide this as a service [\[Amazon 19\]](#ch10-ch10ref43)[\[Google 20b\]](#ch10-ch10ref56).

corrections.reason: Cycle-optimized is execution cycles, not loops
